findings.rationale: Monitor::step rolls back state when a transition violates an invariant, trans, type bound, or ensures clause and exposes the rejected candidate through violation/attempted_state. The refinement checker ignores abs_step.violation and compares the rolled-back abs_step.state, so an implementation whose abstraction stutters can be accepted even though its mapped abstract action was rejected.

LeadsTo expressions require total division semantics, and the surrounding binding/response helpers enable that scope. This fallback trigger probe calls eval directly; when Q is false and P divides or takes a remainder by zero, valid property evaluation aborts with a partial-operation error instead of using the defined value 0.
